jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben
• Du begleitest und unterstützt unsere Patientinnen und Patienten auf der Aufnahme- und Notfallstation 50+ während der Nacht, einfühlsam, aufmerksam und individuell, zum Beispiel bei schlaffördernden Massnahmen.
• Bedürfnis- und ressourcenorientierte Beratung liegen dir am Herzen, sodass jeder Patient optimal betreut wird.
• Im Team meisterst du auch komplexe Situationen souverän und findest gemeinsam schnelle und sichere Lösungen.
• Patienteneintritte führst du zusammen mit der ärztlichen Fachperson durch und hältst alle relevanten Ereignisse sowie deine Leistungen zuverlässig fest.
• In der Nacht sorgst du für den reibungslosen Ablauf und den Unterhalt der Station.
• Bei Bedarf übernimmst du ausserdem Einsätze im Tagdienst und bringst dort deine Erfahrung gewinnbringend ein. Dein Profil
• Du hast eine Ausbildung als Dipl. Pflegefachperson HF/FH abgeschlossen (bei ausländischen Ausbildungen ist die Anerkennung oder ein positiver PreCheck durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz erforderlich).
• Berufserfahrung in der Langzeitpflege oder Psychiatrie bringst du idealerweise mit, am besten aus der Gerontopsychiatrie, oder du bist neugierig, dich in dieses spannende Fachgebiet zu vertiefen.
• Du hast bereits den Basiskurs in Aggressionsmanagement absolviert.
• Soziale Kompetenzen, Belastbarkeit und die Fähigkeit, selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich zu arbeiten, zeichnen dich aus. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du gerne interdisziplinär im Team.
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie sichere EDV-Kenntnisse erleichtern dir die administrativen Aufgaben. descriptionByLocale.it:
I tuoi compiti
• Accompagnate e sostenete i nostri pazienti alla reception e alla stazione di emergenza 50+ durante la notte, sensibili, attenti e individualmente, ad esempio nelle misure di promozione del sonno.
• Il bisogno e la consulenza orientata alle risorse è importante per voi, in modo che ogni paziente è curata in modo ottimale.
• Nel team, si padroneggiano situazioni complesse e trovare soluzioni rapide e sicure insieme.
• Effettuate le voci dei pazienti insieme allo specialista medico e registrate in modo affidabile tutti gli eventi rilevanti e i vostri servizi.
• Di notte, si assicura il funzionamento regolare e la manutenzione della stazione.
• Se necessario, si assume anche incarichi nel servizio diurno e portare la vostra esperienza lì con profitto. Il tuo profilo
• Hai un'educazione come Dipl. Il professionista infermieristico ha completato HF/FH (per la formazione straniera, il riconoscimento o un PreCheck positivo dalla Croce Rossa svizzera è richiesto).
• È idealmente portare esperienza professionale in cura a lungo termine o psichiatria, preferibilmente da gerontopsichiatria, o siete curiosi di approfondire in questo campo emozionante.
• Hai già completato il corso di base nella gestione dell'aggressione.
• Le competenze sociali, la resilienza e la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e indipendente ti distinguono. Allo stesso tempo, ti piace lavorare in una squadra interdisciplinare.
• La conoscenza molto buona del tedesco almeno C1 livello così come le competenze IT sicure rendono i compiti amministrativi più facili per voi. Con circa 1.400 dipendenti, forniamo un trattamento psichiatrico accessibile, personale ed efficace e la cura per gli adulti nei cantoni di St.Gallen e Appenzell Ausserrhoden così come nel Principato del Liechtenstein nelle nostre nove sedi aziendali. Riceverete una conferma telefonica da noi se decidiamo per voi dopo la seconda intervista e vi chiediamo se siete ancora convinti di noi. Se siamo d'accordo, prepareremo il tuo contratto. Così si può ottenere un quadro differenziato della società e già prepararsi per il lavoro. Il primo giorno ci si può aspettare un onboarding nella vostra nuova squadra e con altri colleghi. Your tasks
• You accompany and support our patients at the reception and emergency station 50+ during the night, sensitively, attentively and individually, for example in sleep-promoting measures.
• Need and resource-oriented advice is important to you, so that every patient is optimally cared for.
• In the team, you master complex situations and find fast and secure solutions together.
• You perform patient entries together with the medical specialist and reliably record all relevant events and your services.
• At night, you ensure the smooth running and maintenance of the station.
• If necessary, you also take on assignments in the day service and bring your experience there profitably. Your profile
• You have an education as a Dipl. Nursing professional completed HF/FH (for foreign training, recognition or a positive PreCheck by the Swiss Red Cross is required).
• You ideally bring professional experience in long-term care or psychiatry, preferably from gerontopsychiatry, or you are curious to delve into this exciting field.
• You have already completed the basic course in aggression management.
• Social skills, resilience and the ability to work independently and independently distinguish you. At the same time, you like to work in an interdisciplinary team.
• Very good knowledge of German at at least C1 level as well as secure IT skills make administrative tasks easier for you. Then we will contact you. During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. I tre dipartimenti di ammissione e di emergenza e il dipartimento forense di Wil trattano pazienti malati mentali con disturbi dell'intero spettro di diagnosi psichiatrica. The assignments as a guard are mainly in the evening (18:00 to 03:00) or at night (21:00 to 07:00) in 24/7 operation. Assignments can also take place on weekends and public holidays in day service. • After entering service, your comprehensive information about the patient situation will be provided on the basis of a tour.
• Your expertise provides additional security in the evening, on weekends and public holidays. Your competence strengthens the care teams and enables a flexible response to acute crisis situations in acute psychiatry and forensics.
• If necessary, you will support the other stations in coping with psychiatric or somatic emergency situations or in exceptional work attacks.
• You support the service doctor and night watches in difficult and complex admission situations.
• Important patient-related circumstances and events are documented in detail by you. Your profile

• Advantageously, you already have professional experience in acute psychiatry or gerontop psychiatry.
• You have completed a basic course in aggression management or are ready to complete one.
• You have social skills, are resilient, have an independent and responsible working method and the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team.
• Good IT knowledge makes administrative tasks easier for you. • You support the service doctor and night watches in difficult and complex admission situations.

• Advantageously, you already have professional experience in acute psychiatry or gerontop psychiatry.

• You have social skills, are resilient, have an independent and responsible working method and the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team.
• Good IT knowledge makes administrative tasks easier for you.
